description.sr:
Za prolazak kroz svojstva objekta postoje tri pomoćne funkcije. Svaka vraća niz:
- `Object.keys(obj)` vraća ključeve: `Object.keys({ a: 1, b: 2 })` → `['a', 'b']`
- `Object.values(obj)` vraća vrednosti: → `[1, 2]`
- `Object.entries(obj)` vraća parove `[ključ, vrednost]`: → `[['a', 1], ['b', 2]]`

Napiši funkciju `formatEntries(obj)` koja svako svojstvo objekta pretvara u tekst oblika `'ključ: vrednost'`.

`obj` je objekat čije su vrednosti tekstovi, brojevi ili `true`/`false`. Funkcija vraća niz tekstova, po jedan za svako svojstvo.

Pravila:
- redosled tekstova je isti kao redosled svojstava u objektu
- prazan objekat daje prazan niz
- brojevi i `true`/`false` postaju tekst, a `0`, `false` i `''` se ne preskaču

Primeri:
- `formatEntries({ name: 'Ana', age: 20 })` → `['name: Ana', 'age: 20']`
- `formatEntries({ b: 1, a: 2 })` → `['b: 1', 'a: 2']`, jer redosled ostaje kao u objektu
- `formatEntries({ count: 0, on: false })` → `['count: 0', 'on: false']`
- `formatEntries({ note: '' })` → `['note: ']`, jer je prazan tekst i dalje vrednost
- `formatEntries({})` → `[]`
description.en:
There are three helper functions for going through the properties of an object. Each returns an array:
- `Object.keys(obj)` returns the keys: `Object.keys({ a: 1, b: 2 })` → `['a', 'b']`
- `Object.values(obj)` returns the values: → `[1, 2]`
- `Object.entries(obj)` returns `[key, value]` pairs: → `[['a', 1], ['b', 2]]`

Write a function `formatEntries(obj)` that turns every property of the object into a text of the form `'key: value'`.

`obj` is an object whose values are texts, numbers or `true`/`false`. The function returns an array of texts, one for every property.

Rules:
- the order of the texts is the same as the order of the properties in the object
- an empty object gives an empty array
- numbers and `true`/`false` become text, and `0`, `false` and `''` are not skipped

Examples:
- `formatEntries({ name: 'Ana', age: 20 })` → `['name: Ana', 'age: 20']`
- `formatEntries({ b: 1, a: 2 })` → `['b: 1', 'a: 2']`, because the order stays as in the object
- `formatEntries({ count: 0, on: false })` → `['count: 0', 'on: false']`
- `formatEntries({ note: '' })` → `['note: ']`, because an empty text is still a value
- `formatEntries({})` → `[]`

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function formatEntries` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(obj)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `obj` je objekat čija svojstva ispisujemo. Poziv `formatEntries({ name: 'Ana' })` daje `obj = { name: 'Ana' }`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 7.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function formatEntries` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(obj)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `obj` is the object whose properties we print. The call `formatEntries({ name: 'Ana' })` gives `obj = { name: 'Ana' }`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 7 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Pravimo prazan niz za tekstove.

- `const` jer se promenljiva `result` ne dodeljuje ponovo; sadržaj niza se menja.
- Za prazan objekat petlja se ne izvrši i vraća se upravo ovaj prazan niz, kako zadatak traži.
text.en:
We create an empty array for the texts.

- `const` because the variable `result` is not assigned again; the contents of the array change.
- For an empty object the loop does not run and exactly this empty array is returned, as the task asks.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz parove ključ-vrednost.

- `Object.entries(obj)` vraća niz parova, redom kojim su svojstva u objektu. Za `{ name: 'Ana', age: 20 }` to je `[['name', 'Ana'], ['age', 20]]`.
- `for (const ... of ...)` uzima jedan par po krugu.
- `[key, value]` je destrukturiranje: par je niz od dva elementa, a ovaj zapis odmah daje ime prvom (`key`) i drugom (`value`). Isto je što i `const pair = ...; const key = pair[0]; const value = pair[1];`, samo kraće.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 5.
text.en:
We go through the key-value pairs.

- `Object.entries(obj)` returns an array of pairs, in the order the properties have in the object. For `{ name: 'Ana', age: 20 }` that is `[['name', 'Ana'], ['age', 20]]`.
- `for (const ... of ...)` takes one pair per round.
- `[key, value]` is destructuring: a pair is an array of two elements, and this notation immediately names the first (`key`) and the second (`value`). It is the same as `const pair = ...; const key = pair[0]; const value = pair[1];`, only shorter.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 5.

text.sr:
Pravimo tekst i dodajemo ga u rezultat.

- `key + ': ' + value` nadovezuje ključ, dvotačku sa razmakom i vrednost. Kad je vrednost broj ili `true`/`false`, JavaScript je pretvara u tekst: `'age: ' + 20` je `'age: 20'`.
- Nema provere `if`, pa se `0`, `false` i `''` ne preskaču: `'count: ' + 0` je `'count: 0'`, a `'note: ' + ''` je `'note: '`.
- `result.push(...)` dodaje tekst na kraj niza.

```
obj = { name: 'Ana', age: 20 }
krug  key     value  tekst        result posle kruga
1     'name'  'Ana'  'name: Ana'  ['name: Ana']
2     'age'   20     'age: 20'    ['name: Ana', 'age: 20']
```
text.en:
We build the text and add it to the result.

- `key + ': ' + value` joins the key, a colon with a space and the value. When the value is a number or `true`/`false`, JavaScript turns it into text: `'age: ' + 20` is `'age: 20'`.
- There is no `if` check, so `0`, `false` and `''` are not skipped: `'count: ' + 0` is `'count: 0'`, and `'note: ' + ''` is `'note: '`.
- `result.push(...)` adds the text to the end of the array.

```
obj = { name: 'Ana', age: 20 }
round  key     value  text         result after the round
1      'name'  'Ana'  'name: Ana'  ['name: Ana']
2      'age'   20     'age: 20'    ['name: Ana', 'age: 20']
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 3.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 3.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr: Vraćamo niz tekstova. Objekat `obj` smo samo čitali, nikad menjali.
text.en: We return the array of texts. We only read the object `obj`, never changed it.

note.en: `Object.entries` gives the key and the value together, so there is no extra reading from the object.

- In every round `key` is one key.

text.sr:
Vrednost čitamo iz objekta po ključu i pravimo tekst.

- `obj[key]` čita svojstvo čije ime stoji u promenljivoj `key`. Uglaste zagrade su potrebne jer je ime u promenljivoj; `obj.key` bi tražilo svojstvo koje se doslovno zove `key`.
- `key + ': ' + obj[key]` nadovezuje ključ, dvotačku sa razmakom i vrednost. Brojevi i `true`/`false` se pretvaraju u tekst.
- Nema provere `if`, pa se `0`, `false` i `''` ne preskaču.

```
obj = { name: 'Ana', age: 20 }
krug  key     obj[key]  tekst
1     'name'  'Ana'     'name: Ana'
2     'age'   20        'age: 20'
```
text.en:
We read the value from the object by key and build the text.

- `obj[key]` reads the property whose name is in the variable `key`. Square brackets are needed because the name is in a variable; `obj.key` would look for a property literally called `key`.
- `key + ': ' + obj[key]` joins the key, a colon with a space and the value. Numbers and `true`/`false` are turned into text.
- There is no `if` check, so `0`, `false` and `''` are not skipped.

```
obj = { name: 'Ana', age: 20 }
round  key     obj[key]  text
1      'name'  'Ana'     'name: Ana'
2      'age'   20        'age: 20'
```
